capabilities_done: PLR-069 pigment: PlanExtensions::validate checks the structure of every envelope entry and collects the envelope operators (adjustment, adjustment kind, Blend-If and its clip-role / effects variants, mask feather, effect kinds, effects_nested) of entries addressed to a group reachable from the root only, like RenderPlan::validate (PLR-058) and both backends; admission asks the backend for the effect blend modes of reachable entries only (new PlanExtensions::effect_modes_in; effect_modes stays as the all-entries helper); an unreachable unsupported entry admits and renders nothing, the same entry on a reachable group is refused with the same key

PLR-069 render-cpu: ExtPrep::build prepares the entries of groups in the reachable set only (the sweep prepare uses, now one helper), so an entry on an unreachable group charges nothing to max_working_bytes and cannot be refused there

PLR-070 render-cpu: Renderer carries PlanLimits (the maxima by default); Renderer::with_plan_limits(PlanLimits) tightens them (a field above PlanLimits::MAXIMUM is InvalidConfig, never clamped) and plan_limits() reads them; execute_detailed and execute_extended_detailed, and with them the RenderBackend methods, call admit_with_limits and admit_extended_with_limits with them; a renderer without limits behaves exactly as before

PLR-072: RenderPlan::validate compares the depth budget for every node, a leaf and a group without layers included (depth 1), so max_depth = 0 refuses every plan; error order for every other plan is unchanged

PLR-073: V4-06 regexes and site lists redone for the classes this lane touches (notes.v4_06, notes.v4_06_sites): the old regexes miss render_plan.rs:943 (trait default execute_extended) and extensions.rs:280 (envelope entry loop), the new ones match them; plus the source tripwire test admission_readers_of_nodes_and_entries_are_classified so a new reader of plan nodes or envelope entries fails until it is classified

PLR-074: validate rustdoc, reachable_nodes rustdoc, PlanExtensions::validate rustdoc and DESCRIPTOR topics validate and plan_limits state exactly what holds (operators of unreachable nodes and envelope entries do not count; intrinsic refusals do; max_depth 0 refuses every plan) and cite tests that exist (test descriptor_topics_state_the_rule_and_cite_existing_tests parses the DESCRIPTOR and checks every citation); render-cpu DESCRIPTOR keys plan_limits and envelope_reach

PLR-075: the clip base is tracked while walking the layers (one step per layer) instead of a backwards search per clipped layer; a group of 65536 layers with 65535 clipped validates in well under a second (origin: 33 s)

RenderPlan::validate: max_depth below 1 now refuses a lone leaf and a group without layers (TooDeep); before, a plan without a layer was never depth-checked. Defaults are unchanged (depth 64)

render-cpu: an envelope entry on an unreachable group is not prepared, so its resident bytes are not charged: receipts of such a plan show a lower peak_working_bytes and no ledger line for the entry (the plan digest still binds the whole envelope)
decisions_for_lead: 1. Intrinsic envelope refusals stay on every entry. A knockout other than none, an adjustment kind without a formula and an effect feature pigment refuses (PlanError::KnockoutUnsupported, AdjustmentUnsupported, EffectUnsupported) are typed errors, not operators a backend declares, so an unreachable entry carrying one is still refused (test intrinsic_envelope_refusals_stay_on_every_entry). Making them reachable-only too is a small change in PlanExtensions::validate (guard the three returns with counts) plus flipping that test; not done because the lead decision names operators.

2. render-gpu adoption (PLR-070 remainder): plan_sink.rs:964/965 still call admit / admit_extended with default limits. Wait for D20, then copy the render-cpu pattern (a PlanLimits field, a fallible with_plan_limits, admit_with_limits / admit_extended_with_limits). render-gpu already looks entries up per executed layer, so no reachability change is needed there.

3. The envelope effect budgets (MAX_EFFECTS_PER_LAYER 64, MAX_EFFECTS_PER_PLAN 4096) are still fixed constants outside PlanLimits (extensions.rs validate); tightening them needs a new PlanLimits field added through a builder, since hosts build PlanLimits by literal.
